      "code": "\nlibrary(jsonlite)\n\n# Study parameters\nn <- 25\nmean_increase <- 0.2\nsd <- 0.5\nalpha <- 0.05\nside <- \"one.sided\"\n\n# Calculate Cohen's d\ncohens_d <- mean_increase / sd\n\n# For one-sample t-test:\n# Null hypothesis: μ = 0\n# Alternative hypothesis (one-sided, upper tail): μ > 0\n# \n# Under the alternative hypothesis, the true mean is 0.2\n# The test statistic is t = (sample_mean - 0) / (sample_sd / sqrt(n))\n# Under H1, this follows a non-central t distribution with:\n#   df = n - 1 = 24\n#   non-centrality parameter λ = (true_mean - null_mean) / (σ / sqrt(n))\n#                              = (true_mean) / (σ / sqrt(n))\n#                              = d * sqrt(n)\n\ndf <- n - 1\nncp <- cohens_d * sqrt(n)\n\n# For a one-sided test at alpha = 0.05, the critical value is the upper tail\n# critical_value = t_{1-alpha, df}\ncritical_value <- qt(1 - alpha, df)\n\n# Power = P(t_{df, ncp} > critical_value)\n# This is the upper-tail probability of the non-central t distribution\npower <- pt(critical_value, df, ncp = ncp, lower.tail = FALSE)\n\n# Prepare result\nresult <- list(\n  metric = \"power\",\n  value = power,\n  unit = \"probability\"\n)\n\ncat(\"POWER_AGENT_RESULT=\")\ncat(toJSON(list(results = list(result)), auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15))\n",
